# Rhythmiq

> Rhythmiq is voice AI for D2C ecommerce brands. It calls customers to rescue failed deliveries, confirm cash-on-delivery orders, turn returns into exchanges, and win back abandoned carts, 24/7 in 12+ languages. Plans start at $499 a month including 1,200 calls, billed per call rather than per minute.

Most brands only ever hear from the half of their customers who reply to a text. Rhythmiq calls the other half. These are calls that were never worth paying a person to make, and they are the ones quietly costing D2C brands money every day: a courier who could not reach anyone, a refund request that should have been a size swap, a COD order nobody confirmed before it shipped.

Rhythmiq is a finished product for ecommerce operators, not a developer platform you assemble yourself. It runs on your own catalogue and return policy, writes outcomes back to your store and OMS, and hands off to a human with the full transcript when it should. This file is a guide for language models to the most useful pages on rhythmiqcx.com. Every URL below is live and canonical.

## What Rhythmiq actually does

Six calls make up the product today:

1. **Failed delivery rescue.** Outbound, about 45 seconds. The courier tried once and nobody was in. Rhythmiq calls, captures a new time slot, corrects the address if needed, and writes it back before the parcel ships home.
2. **Return turned into an exchange.** Outbound, about 90 seconds. Instead of logging a refund, the agent offers a size swap, store credit, or a discount, and keeps the sale.
3. **COD confirmation with an upsell.** Outbound, about 60 seconds. One call confirms a cash-on-delivery order and adds a matching item to the same parcel.
4. **Reorder reminder.** Outbound, about 45 seconds. A month's supply is running low, so Rhythmiq offers to send the next one today.
5. **Where is my order, inbound.** The single most common reason anyone calls an online store, answered instantly with real tracking data.
6. **Abandoned cart recovery.** Outbound, about 60 seconds. A call reaches the customers who never opened the recovery email.

## Common questions

- **What does Rhythmiq cost?** Growth is $499 a month including 1,200 calls. Scale is $1,499 including 5,000 calls and adds returns-to-exchange handling plus all 12+ languages. Past 20,000 calls a month, Enterprise is priced on usage from $0.18 a call.
- **Is it billed per minute or per call?** Per completed call. Most of these calls run under 90 seconds, and a per-minute meter penalises the conversations that go well. Overage past your included calls bills at a published rate, $0.38 on Growth and $0.30 on Scale.
- **Is it inbound or outbound?** Both. Five of the six use cases are outbound calls the brand initiates; "where is my order" is inbound.
- **Does it handle languages other than English?** Yes, 12+ on Pro and Enterprise, including Arabic, Spanish, and Hindi, and a customer can switch language mid-sentence without breaking the call.
- **How is this different from Retell, Bland, Vapi, or Synthflow?** Those are per-minute developer platforms you build on. Rhythmiq is the finished ecommerce product, on a flat plan, with the return and delivery logic already built.
- **Can it really change a refund into an exchange?** Yes. That is the flagship use case. The agent handles the objection live rather than reading from a script.
